basic_info.description: Experience unparalleled luxury in this top-floor penthouse at Maison Pacific, nestled in the heart of Russian Hill. This expansive residence offers nearly 2,000 sqft of sophisticated living space, featuring three generously sized bedrooms and an open floor plan designed for modern living.  The north-facing orientation ensures breathtaking Russian Hill, the Bay, and Marin Headlands vistas. Floor-to-ceiling windows and a private balcony invite abundant natural light, enhancing the home's airy ambiance. The European-style kitchen is a culinary enthusiast's dream, equipped with premium appliances and sleek finishes.  Residents of Maison Pacific enjoy a suite of premium amenities, including a lobby attendant, rooftop terrace with panoramic city views, BBQ grill, and outdoor seating areas perfect for social gatherings. Secure, freestanding parking with EV charger and dedicated bike storage also included, ensuring convenience and peace of mind.  Situated at the convergence of Pacific Heights, Nob Hill, and Russian Hill, this residence offers unparalleled access to San Francisco's most esteemed neighborhoods. A variety of cafes, boutiques, popular restaurants, and local grocers line this stretch of Polk Street, providing a unique day-to-day living experience.
